businessModel: Search-engine deals, sponsored speed dials, gaming partnerships and affiliate promotions; free product
updateCadence: Major GX updates every few months plus Chromium-based core updates; lags Chromium by several versions
summary: Free Chromium browser for gamers with CPU, RAM and network limiters, Hot Tabs Killer, GX Mods (11,000+), a native ad blocker, free VPN and Opera AI. Now on Windows, macOS, Linux (Mar 2026), Android and iOS.
bestFor: Gamers who want a browser with resource caps
People who like heavy theming and mods
Users who want built-in music/Twitch/Discord sidebars

pros.title: GX Control limiters
pros.detail: Cap CPU, RAM and network use of the browser; Hot Tabs Killer closes heavy tabs.

pros.title: Massive customisation
pros.detail: Over 11,000 GX Mods plus themes, sounds and shaders.

pros.title: Native ad blocker
pros.detail: Summer 2026 update added a faster blocker with uBlock filter compatibility.

pros.title: New in Oct 2026
pros.detail: Volume Booster up to 500% and an 8-preset Audio Equalizer per tab.

pros.title: Broad platform reach
pros.detail: Windows, macOS, Linux (since Mar 2026), Android and iOS.

cons.title: Weak privacy posture
cons.detail: Sponsored content, telemetry and an ad-driven business model.

cons.title: Chromium patch lag
cons.detail: GX core 126 shipped on Chromium 142 in Jan 2026 while Chrome was newer.

cons.title: MV2 not guaranteed
cons.detail: Opera says it supports MV2 "as long as we can" with no end date; GX-specific confirmation is missing.

cons.title: AI and promos in the UI
cons.detail: Opera AI and promotional content appear by default.

signatureFeatures: Native ad blocker and free VPN

faq.q: Is Opera GX only for gamers?
faq.a: No. It is a regular Chromium browser with extras; the limiters and mods help gamers most.

faq.q: Is there Opera GX on Linux?
faq.a: Yes, GX launched on Linux in March 2026 with built-in ad blocker and VPN.

faq.q: Does GX still support uBlock Origin?
faq.a: Opera says it supports MV2 extensions like uBlock Origin for as long as it can; the built-in blocker also uses uBlock filter lists.
